system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Starships of the Galaxy

Emplacement Points: 1

A Proton Torpedo Launcher carries a Starship's Proton Torpedo payload. A standard Proton Torpedo Launcher holds three Proton Torpedoes (see below). Additional capacity may be added, increasing the cost by 25% for each additional Proton Torpedo (up to a maximum of sixteen Proton Torpedoes).

Proton Torpedoes

Proton Torpedoes use a proton-scattering warhead that essentially causes a miniature nuclear explosion on the target's surface. Because of their small size and compact launcher (see above), they are preferred for Starfighters and other relatively small vessels. All Proton Torpedoes have a 4-square Splash radius.
